see_for_yourself.expected: The event's day is greyed but can still be ticked; each ticked date gets a one-off 19:00 to 22:00; both views show the same times.
steps: Put one evening event in your Google Calendar inside the request's dates
On the request page, tap Add 19:00 to 22:00, allow clashes if asked, and tick three evenings including that day
Save, then switch My times between calendar and list
see_for_yourself.title: Answer a request from your phone

what_just_landed.detail: Tick several dates and give them the same times; each becomes its own one-off time. From a request, only its dates and times of day are offered.
what_just_landed.title: A calendar for your availability

what_just_landed.detail: After allowing it once, days busy in your Google Calendar during the chosen times are greyed each time the page opens, and can still be picked.
what_just_landed.title: Google Calendar clashes greyed

what_just_landed.detail: Tap a start and an end on quarter-hour cells, or drag with a mouse; typing still works. My times shows as a calendar or a list.
what_just_landed.title: A tap grid for every time
